title: Keep replaced-runtime start frames from borrowing the current project environment selection
outcome: A late frame from a replaced runtime cannot acquire the replacement runtime's environment-presence decision when creating a visibility observation.
acceptance: Use existing frame-disposition/provenance ownership so a non-current start frame never binds the current runtime's project environment selection; preserve intended visibility history, runtime fences and absence of native/mediated credit.

A deterministic fixture replaces a runtime missing a declared name with one that has it, then delivers the old runtime's start/end frames and checks the old visibility row cannot become a configured PASS while current-runtime checks remain correct.
